card.name: The word other after hypersensitivity to X or
card.fires_on: The word "other" right after "or" or "to any" in contraindication lists, following a named drug the patient is hypersensitive to. It comes just before "ingredients", "components" or a drug class.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity to drug or other
modes.description: "other" after a named drug and "or" in a contraindication or allergy statement.
modes.example: Known hypersensitivity to amphetamine products or<< other>> ingredients of lisdexamfetamine

modes.label: Uppercase warning version
modes.description: The same phrase in all-caps allergy warnings about penicillins and cephalosporins.
modes.example: SHOULD BE MADE CONCERNING PREVIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS TO PENICILLINS, CEPHALOSPORINS OR<< OTHER>> ALLERGENS.

modes.description: A weaker case outside drug text, where "to" follows "the second way".
